Travel & Hospitality

Official Venue

Faith Nexus 2026 will be hosted at a premier, high-fidelity venue in Johannesburg, South Africa (detailed coordinates will be provided to registered delegates).

Visa Assistance

International delegates requiring visas will receive official invitation letters and logistical support once registration is confirmed and paid.

Elite Accommodation

We have partnered with leading luxury hotels near the venue to offer exclusive rates for Faith Nexus delegates. Booking links will be sent post-registration.

Local Transport

Shuttle services will be available between partner hotels and the summit venue. Airport transfers can be booked via our hospitality desk.
